ICS 31.220.10LITD 03New Standard from Last Update.NATIONAL FOREWORDThis Indian Standard (Part 4/Sec 116) which is identical with IEC 61076-4-116 : 2015 ‘Connectors for electronic equipment - Product requirements - Part 4-116: Printed board connectors - Detail specification for a high-speed two-part connector with integrated shielding function’ issued by the International Electro technical Commission (IEC) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on recommendation of the Electromechanical Components and Mechanical Structures for Electronic Equipment’s Sectional Committee and approval of the Electronics and Information Technology Division Council.
